mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees with overcast skies near City Hall. If you are looking up tonight, the International Space Station will be visible for 4 minutes starting at 8:27 PM, moving from the northwest over Middleton toward the northeast near Madison.

Public Works announced that chip sealing begins September 23 on roads like Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, with lane closures expected between 9 AM and 3 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review various development projects on October 5, including sites at 201 South Main Street and in the Liberty Business Park.

Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli and the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square, followed by Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park this Saturday.

In a recent report, police detailed an incident from September 5 where officers discovered vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several streets, noting that this was related to a social media prank known as the dairy dare.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM, but please note that the store is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
